purpose: Descriptive CPU shell-process fallback for issue 316 ASR-only versus ASR plus optional S1 Q4; no fast/Vulkan or mobile APK claim
environment: Discharging unplugged, screen OFF, thermal<2, battery<42C; no app or settings changes. Abort on violation or missing required telemetry.
sequence: idle with no owned Starling process
ASR-only: launch baseline IQ2 Parakeet CPU server, eager load and built-in silent-clip warmup, wait /health ready
ASR plus optional S1: retain ASR process, launch Q4_K_M S1 CPU server, eager load and built-in probe-text warmup, wait /health ready
stop both owned servers; recovery snapshot
sampling: At each stage take three /proc/meminfo and per-owned-PID smaps_rollup/status samples about five seconds apart. Preserve raw samples, selected CPU backend logs, process PIDs and launch-to-ready times. No long user transcript or inference campaign.
bounds: ASR readiness <=180 s, S1 readiness <=180 s, whole run <=9 min; stop owned servers on timeout/failure and verify absence. Do not retry or change phone settings.
analysis: Report observed per-process PSS/RSS and VmHWM; global MemAvailable range at idle, ASR-only, and co-resident stages. No additive GPU claim; these servers explicitly request ggml CPU. The 2 GiB target and 2-3 GiB available headroom are provisional soft engineering preferences, not pass/fail acceptance. Shell processes are not the mobile app's process limit or proof of foreground user-app behavior. Do not attribute all global memory movement to Starling.
